title: Stack block (blocks/*.yml)
description: A composition block per ADR 0008. scripts/materialize-runtime.mjs reads these and produces .claude/config/runtime.yml. The top-level key list here mirrors BLOCK_KEYS in that script (materialize-runtime.mjs:60-73); a key not listed there is warned about and dropped, so adding one here without adding it there produces a schema that validates files the engine silently ignores.

name.description: Block id as referenced from project.yml stack_blocks. A project-local block under .claude/blocks/ is referenced as './name'.

axis.description: Which dimension of the stack this block occupies. Two blocks on the same axis conflict. Only a block with axis 'architecture' may contribute orchestrate.layers (materialize-runtime.mjs:424).

requires.description: Blocks that must also be present in stack_blocks. A missing one is a hard failure, not a warning (materialize-runtime.mjs:349).

requires_ecc.description: Declares the block's dependency on the ECC plugin explicitly, rather than leaving it to guesswork.

extends.description: Inherit from another block. Exactly one level — a base that itself extends is rejected (materialize-runtime.mjs:272).

params.description: Parameters the block expects from project.yml block_params.<name>. Values substitute into ${...} placeholders in the rest of the block.

type.description: A trailing '[]' marks a list; an empty list counts as absent when checking 'required'.

patterns.description: Which pattern files this block puts in front of agents.

always.description: Paths relative to patterns/, always injected.

remove.description: Paths another block added that this block withdraws.

overlay.description: Extra assets linked into the project on setup.

env.description: Environment variables written into runtime.yml. Two blocks setting the same key to different values is a hard failure (materialize-runtime.mjs:469).

analyze.description: The /analyze phase: the advisory panel and how the phase ends.

exit.description: PAUSE makes approval a hard gate and wins over any other value contributed by another block (materialize-runtime.mjs:413).

orchestrate.description: The /orchestrate phase. Only one block in a composition may define 'layers' (materialize-runtime.mjs:418).

layer_contributions.description: Adds patterns to layers another block owns. 'match' is required (materialize-runtime.mjs:435).

budgets.description: Per-stage tool-call ceilings. Keyed by stage name.

ralphinho.description: Parallel fan-out execution settings. First block to declare it wins (materialize-runtime.mjs:440).

pattern_routing.description: Consumed by a DIFFERENT generator — scripts/generate-pattern-routing.mjs builds hooks/lib/pattern-routing.generated.js from it. Never reaches runtime.yml; it is listed in BLOCK_KEYS only so materialization does not report it as a typo.

tags.description: RESERVED — declaring it passes validation but nothing consumes it yet (materialize-runtime.mjs:74).

match.description: A regex; an invalid one fails materialization (materialize-runtime.mjs:948).

pattern.description: Path under patterns/. A pattern that does not exist fails materialization (materialize-runtime.mjs:945).
